message.content: I'm ending my turn. I have $0 cash, but I spent it on houses for my dark blues and reds, so those properties now charge more rent. If I owe money later, I can still mortgage my seven unmortgaged properties or sell houses then, so there's no reason to do that now. I'm also not trading Atlantic Avenue to Gemini, because it would give them the full yellow set.
message.reasoning:
With $0 cash I'm exposed if I land on p1's pink properties with houses or hit income tax, but I can mortgage properties on demand to cover costs, so sitting at zero isn't necessarily dangerous right now.

Trading Atlantic to p4 crossed my mind, but that would complete their yellow monopoly with Ventnor and Marvin, which is too risky. Better to just end my turn.

function.name: end_turn
function.arguments: {"public_message": "Dark blues at three houses each, reds at two. Board's getting expensive, gentlemen. Your roll, Gemini."}
